notes.title: BLESSINGS Update (v4.0)
notes.content:
[b]4.0 is here![/b] with cosmetics, achievements and lots of quality of life changes!
[i]Pray to the angel statue to be blessed.[/i]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/LS7Ai72.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/LS7Ai72.png[/img][/url]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Angel statue[/b]
[i]The angel statue will bless you[/i]

[*][b]Added several cosmetics[/b]
[*]Wizard hat
[*]Golden chestplate
[*]Double bladed axe
[*]Sun staff
[*]Added achievement for completing the entire game without using a single teleport
[*]Added looking up and down
[/list]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/cFsEnsC.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/cFsEnsC.png[/img][/url]

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now cancel your attack with jump
[*]You will always face the enemy you are fighting
[*]You can hold down and walk to walk slowly
[i]This is fantastic for positioning yourself for a difficult jump[/i]
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed scaling of charge attack (a lot more powerful than before)
[*]Changed souls bonus upgrade from 0.2 > 0.3
[*]Tiny blue goblins now give 30 souls instead of 10
[*]Tons of visual changes to help colorblind people
[*]Made Astralions appear hitbox bigger

[*][b]Nebulon Changes[/b]
[*]Made several jumps easier

[*][b]Mirestone Forge Changes[/b]
[*]Moves around platforms to compensate for unfair falls
[*]Muglars workshop has several changes
[/list]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/UBDFqzd.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/UBDFqzd.png[/img][/url]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a pause bug while on a bonfire
[*]Fixed other minor bugs
[/list]

[i]with this update, you can never fall again-[/i]
